This occurred at 22:14–22:20 UTC, well outside the principal's baseline hours (08:00–17:00), and from source IP 10.20.7.88 which does not appear in the baseline addresses (10.20.4.61/62). Although the analyst_ro role technically grants SELECT on vendors, the combination of after-hours access, anomalous source IP, and full extraction of sensitive financial columns from an external contractor account warrants a temporary lock on the specific Teleport principal while the incident is investigated. set -euo pipefail

# 1. Lock the Teleport principal to prevent further access (24h TTL, auto-expires)
tctl lock --user=eve.contractor@eproc.test \

  --message="ALRT-0001: Suspected bulk exfiltration of sensitive vendor columns (tax_id, bank_account) outside normal hours from unusual source IP 10.20.7.88. Pending investigation."

FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE usename = 'analyst_ro'

"

SELECT *
FROM public.audit_log
WHERE teleport_user = 'eve.contractor@eproc.test'
  AND session_id = 'd61caa74-d686-4c64-8bbf-40dcf733ae1a';
"
